units.title: Retention challenge 1
units.lesson: Retrieve the idea from memory before reading the feedback. A small recall result is evidence from these questions only.
units.question: Which combination belongs in caries-risk assessment beyond a current cavity count?
choices: Risk and protective factors plus relevant clinical/contextual information
Only the number of existing cavities in isolation
A guaranteed prediction from the child’s age alone
units.explanation: Risk assessment combines several domains rather than equating risk with an isolated present count.
rationales: Present count alone is not the whole assessment.
Age alone does not guarantee an outcome.
